protocol.name: TBBT frozen BDMTF intervention-prediction fidelity
protocol.estimand: Average 30-day log change in within-community daily comment volume relative to the qualified synthetic-control counterfactual.
protocol.prediction_rule: Predictions use only TBBT IN-BEFORE records, previously frozen BDMTF parameters, independent Lemmy validation parameters, and pre-outcome qualification diagnostics.
protocol.scoring_rule: The prediction process cannot open the observed intervention-effects file. A separate scoring process unseals it after frozen predictions and their hashes exist.
protocol.evidence_boundary: The analyst had already seen aggregate TBBT effects before this protocol was created. This is a retrospectively protocol-frozen mechanism check, not a prospective, preregistered, or analyst-blind prediction.

parameter_sources.external_traffic_multiplier: Frozen learned-BDMTF simulation source: external traffic multiplies target volume by 1.1.
parameter_sources.conflict_response_coefficient: Frozen legacy-BDMTF response in the revision simulator: volume multiplier is 1 + 0.75 * conflict intensity.
parameter_sources.hostile_dropout_probability: Minimum nonzero value in the frozen reviewer ablation grid.
parameter_sources.expected_toxic_activation_boost: Frozen exact-reproduction configuration; not fitted to TBBT.
parameter_sources.expected_visibility_remaining: Selected on the independent Lemmy validation split; not fitted to TBBT.
